bullets: Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(W^T Z + b)
Class of vector Z is sign([W^T Z]^2 + b)

layout.arrangement: A single white slide enclosed by a thin bright-red rectangular frame. Header row across the top: a small blue-outlined italic kicker box at top-left ('Example: Quadratic Kernel'), the large bold red title 'How to Kernelize SVM' centered, and a yellow circular badge with the slide number '36' at top-right. Below the header, a wide blue-outlined panel (upper panel) holds the original SVM dual objective on its first line, a row of two blue-outlined sub-boxes (W equation on the left, b equation on the right) on its second line, and a peach/orange-outlined 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(...)' strip centered beneath them. In the vertical middle of the slide sits a narrow horizontal strip: a thin red-outlined box reading 'Kernelize using' immediately followed by a red-outlined box containing the red bold formula 'K(α,b) = α^T b^2'; a red-outlined white downward arrow hangs from this strip pointing into the lower panel. The lower blue-outlined panel mirrors the upper one: kernelized dual objective on line 1, the same W box on the left and the squared b box on the right on line 2, and a peach 'Class of vector Z is sign(...)' strip on line 3. A black video letterbox bar runs along the very bottom edge of the frame.

regions.name: Header row
regions.content: Left: blue-bordered white rectangle with italic blue text 'Example: Quadratic Kernel' ('Example:' italic, 'Quadratic Kernel' bold italic). Center: bold red title 'How to Kernelize SVM'. Right: yellow filled circle with black '36'.

regions.name: Original SVM panel (upper blue-outlined box)
regions.content: Line 1: dual objective ℒ_D(α) = Σ α_i − 1/2 ΣΣ α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j), with the trailing (X_i^T X_j) inside a light-green rounded highlight. Line 2: left blue-outlined box 'W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i' (W blue bold, α_i y_i X_i red bold); right blue-outlined box 'b = − 1/2 { max_{i,y=−1} (W^T X_i) + min_{i,y=+1} (W^T X_i) }' (b blue bold, max/min red italic, both (W^T X_i) terms in light-green highlights). Line 3: peach-filled, orange-outlined strip 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(W^T Z + b)' with Z in bold green, ⇒ in red, and W^T Z in a light-green highlight.

regions.name: Kernelization connector strip
regions.content: Thin red-outlined rounded rectangle containing italic black text 'Kernelize using' on the left and a separate red-outlined box on the right holding bold red 'K(α,b) = α^T b^2'.

regions.name: Downward arrow
regions.content: Vertical downward-pointing arrow with white fill and red outline, connecting the kernelization strip to the lower panel.

regions.name: Kernelized SVM panel (lower blue-outlined box)
regions.content: Line 1: dual objective ℒ_D(α) = Σ α_i − 1/2 ΣΣ α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j)^2, with (X_i^T X_j)^2 in a light-green rounded highlight. Line 2: left blue-outlined box 'W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i'; right blue-outlined box 'b = − 1/2 { max_{i,y=−1} [W^T X_i]^2 + min_{i,y=+1} [W^T X_i]^2 }' with both squared terms in light-green highlights. Line 3: peach-filled, orange-outlined strip 'Class of vector Z is sign([W^T Z]^2 + b)' with Z in bold green and [W^T Z]^2 in a light-green highlight.

regions.name: Video letterbox bar
regions.content: Solid black horizontal bar (video capture artifact), not part of the slide design.

layout.hierarchy: The bold red title 'How to Kernelize SVM' is the largest, heaviest element and dominates the top. recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with a white (#FFFFFF) background. Draw a thin bright-red (#E00000) rectangle outline inset from the edges (roughly 6% from left/right, 7% from top, 4% from bottom) to frame the content.

2. Header: at top-left (approx. x 7%, y 9%) add a white rectangle with a thin blue (#0000CC) border containing the italic blue text 'Example: Quadratic Kernel', with 'Quadratic Kernel' in bold italic. At top-center add the title 'How to Kernelize SVM' in bold red (#CC0000) sans-serif, ~28 pt. At top-right (approx. x 91%, y 13%) add a yellow (#FFFF99) circle, ~0.9 inch diameter, with a thin dark outline and the black number '36' centered inside.

3. Upper panel: draw a large white rectangle with a thin blue (#0000CC) border spanning approx. x 7%-92%, y 18%-46%. Inside, on the first line, typeset the equation 'ℒ_D(α) = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i − 1/2 Σ_{j=1}^{N} Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j)' in serif math style: ℒ_D in blue calligraphic, α_i in red bold, the rest black; place a light-green (#CCFFCC) rounded rectangle with a green (#00CC00) outline behind the final term (X_i^T X_j).

4. Upper panel line 2: on the left (approx. x 9%-25%) add a thin blue-bordered white box with 'W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i', W in bold blue and α_i y_i X_i in bold red. On the right (approx. x 36%-77%) add a wider thin blue-bordered white box with 'b = − 1/2 { max_{i,y=−1} (W^T X_i) + min_{i,y=+1} (W^T X_i) }', b in bold blue, max/min in red italic, and light-green rounded highlights behind each (W^T X_i).

5. Upper panel line 3: add a peach (#FDEADA) rectangle with a thin orange (#FF9900) border, centered, containing 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(W^T Z + b)' — 'Class of vector' and 'sign(' and '+ b)' in black, 'Z' in bold green, '⇒' in red, and a light-green rounded highlight behind W^T Z.

6. Middle connector: at approx. x 30%-62%, y 49%-56%, draw a thin red-outlined rounded rectangle; inside its left half place italic black text 'Kernelize using', and inside its right half draw a second red-outlined rectangle containing bold red 'K(α,b) = α^T b^2'.

7. Add a downward arrow (white fill, red #E00000 outline, slim shaft with triangular head) centered at approx. x 44%, extending from y 47% down to y 59%, overlapping the gap between the connector strip and the lower panel.

8. Lower panel: draw a second large white rectangle with a thin blue border spanning approx. x 7%-92%, y 61%-91%. Line 1: 'ℒ_D(α) = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i − 1/2 Σ_{j=1}^{N} Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j)^2' with the same color coding and a light-green rounded highlight behind (X_i^T X_j)^2.

9. Lower panel line 2: repeat the left W box ('W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i', W blue bold, α_i y_i X_i red bold) and add a right blue-bordered box with 'b = − 1/2 { max_{i,y=−1} [W^T X_i]^2 + min_{i,y=+1} [W^T X_i]^2 }', b blue bold, max/min red italic, and light-green rounded highlights behind each [W^T X_i]^2.

10. Lower panel line 3: add a peach rectangle with thin orange border containing 'Class of vector Z is sign([W^T Z]^2 + b)' — 'Class of vector' and 'is' and 'sign(' and '+ b)' in black, 'Z' in bold green, and a light-green rounded highlight behind [W^T Z]^2.

11. Optionally overlay a small white mouse-pointer cursor graphic (gray outline, angled up-left) at approx. x 63%, y 78%, just left of the min_{i,y=+1} term in the lower b equation, to reproduce the video-capture artifact.
